selected_evidence.requirement: node1 configured as writable primary with replication enabled
selected_evidence.summary: node1 initdb, postgresql.conf/pg_hba.conf replication config, firewall port opened, postgresql started, replicator role created

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured as read-only standbys via streaming replication
selected_evidence.summary: pg_basebackup -R clone from node1 on both nodes producing standby.signal/primary_conninfo, then postgresql started on both

selected_evidence.requirement: Streaming replication actively working, standbys read-only
selected_evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both standbys streaming; pg_is_in_recovery() true on node2/node3

selected_evidence.requirement: Changes committed on primary visible on both standbys
selected_evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 appears on node2 and node3; standby write attempts fail with read-only error

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 45c22b1f, reboot ack, timeout/reset during reboot, new boot_id 864363ae confirmed changed, postgresql active/in-recovery with data intact post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fb2aa416, reboot ack, timeout/reset during reboot, new boot_id c9f0f919 confirmed changed, postgresql active/in-recovery with data intact post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state, replication resumed
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bccb87ac and pre-restart replication confirmed active, reboot ack, timeouts during reboot, new boot_id c54395b9 confirmed changed, postgresql active as writable primary, new write replicated live to both reconnected standbys

# Replication settings
listen_addresses = '*'
wal_level = replica
max_wal_senders = 10
max_replication_slots = 10
hot_standby = on
EOF

EOF
